workstreams.name: Core liability framework (§§ 1295, 1298, 1299 ABGB)
workstreams.goal: Establish fault-based liability elements: Rechtsgutsverletzung, Kausalität, Verschulden, Rechtswidrigkeit

workstreams.name: Informed consent & causation defense (§ 1313a, § 1325 ABGB)
workstreams.goal: Assess validity of consent defense and impact of omitted specific risk disclosure on causation

workstreams.name: Damages & future loss (Schmerzengeld, Verdienstentgang, Feststellung)
workstreams.goal: Determine compensability, quantification, and legal basis for future damage recognition

synthesis_focus: Causation under § 1295 ABGB in light of incomplete Risikoaufklärung (§ 1313a ABGB) and its effect on fault-based liability and future damage recognition in medical malpractice.
